audit.slidingDoors: Traversable openings require open leaves in playback; never treat windows as doors
audit.orientationMethod: subject-tracking gaze curves with explicit chapter timing and offline smoothing; no per-frame feedback
audit.pace: 按正常看房节奏连续移动，缩短绕行和重复转头，不填满固定时长
audit.motion: one connected collision-checked path, time allocated by path distance and smooth head rotation
